label: Imaging of Ocular Surface Lesions Using Anterior Segment Optical Coherence Tomography.
summary: Ocular surface lesions encompass a wide spectrum of entities ranging from benign degenerative lesions to non-invasive and invasive malignant tumours. Accurate clinical differentiation is essential to ensure timely management. In this manuscript, we describe a series of benign and malignant ocular surface lesions and their clinical and specific imaging findings on anterior segment optical coherence tomography (AS-OCT), highlighting the diagnostic utility of this non-invasive imaging modality.
